name: Akizora ni Mau Confetti
original_name: 秋空に舞うコンフェティ
source:
One autumn day, Hayato met a young girl who was standing with an umbrella in the pouring rain. Picking up the notebook which he thought was hers, his normal life gradually changes. He visits the drama club to look for the owner of the notebook. There he meets various club members: Saya, the girl he met before, who is also a screenwriter; Yuki, his classmate who is an amazing actor; Nanami, his tennen dojikko apartment manager who is also the club leader; and Kanae, a mysterious girl with amnesia who he found collapsed on the roof. He joins the club to help revive it and becomes the lead in the upcoming original play about an urban legend. With each passing day of practice, his monochrome world gradually turns into color.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
秋日的一天，隼人在倾盆大雨中遇见一名撑伞伫立的少女。他捡起一本以为属于她的笔记本，平凡的日常也由此逐渐改变。为了寻找笔记本的主人，他来到戏剧社，并在那里结识了各位社员：先前遇到、同时担任编剧的沙夜；演技惊人的同班同学雪；天然冒失、既是公寓管理员也是社长的七海；以及被他发现倒在屋顶、失去记忆的神秘少女奏衣。他为了帮助戏剧社复兴而加入其中，并担任即将上演的原创都市传说剧主角。随着排练一天天推进，他那黑白单调的世界也渐渐染上色彩。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
